# Phase Robotics

> Phase Robotics builds small precision actuators for robot hands and dexterous manipulators, and the machines that make them. Its aim is to build the motor supply chain in the United States.

Website: https://phaserobotics.cc/
Contact: founders@phaserobotics.cc

## In development

- Lunar Drive: a servo drive that turns a brushless motor into a smart, chainable servo. Status: in the lab.
- Phalanx Drive: an integrated actuator with drive, motor and gearing in one package. Status: taking shape.
- Winder-1: Phase's own machines for making motors, built so the company can iterate, scale and not rely on others. Status: running in-house.

## Topics

Robotics, robotic actuators, precision actuators, brushless motors, servo drives, robot hands, dexterous manipulation, US motor manufacturing.
